title: A reader can see another reader's loans
description: Reported in an audit: GET /readers/11/loans with the header X-Reader: 10 returns reader 11's loans. This is an IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference). Only the reader themselves may see their loans.
criteria: loansForReader throws AccessError when requestedBy is different from readerId or is empty
the server returns 403 in those cases and 200 for the reader themselves
a test that reproduces the attack (reader 10 asking for reader 11's loans) and now gets 403
